decisions.reason: As a useful visualization add-on to the core web-GIS stack, it still supports customer solutions even if its standalone visibility appears lower than at launch.

This niche search add-on is less central to the firm's platform direction and, given the earlier pruning of another search extension, its resources are better concentrated on core platform capabilities and newer developments.
Mobile map usability remains relevant for enterprise and public-sector users, so the component is worth retaining although it faces some risk of being folded into broader platform functionality.
As the flagship GIS platform aligned with the firm's strategic direction, it is highly unlikely to be withdrawn.
Mobile field data capture fits well with integrated geospatial workflows and remains a commercially sensible adjacent product for the firm's customer base.
